familyMethod.caveat: A lexical title-family match is not proof of a franchise relationship and receives strong shrinkage toward the global baseline.

financialContext.caveat: Revenue exceeding production budget is not the same as profitability; marketing and distribution costs are unavailable.

methodology.outcomeMetric: TMDB vote_average (community rating), scaled from 0-10 to 0-100
methodology.notAProxyFor: Rotten Tomatoes Tomatometer or Kalshi threshold probability
runtimeInputs: Kalshi event title selects an optional, strongly-shrunk lexical title-family prior.
Kalshi settlement month selects historical release-month context as an explicit proxy.
leakageControls: Only released films on or before the dataset snapshot are outcomes.
Kalshi price, bid, ask, volume, and market sentiment are not score inputs.
Trailer, search, social, critic, popularity, and review text are not score inputs.
Missing target genres and talent are explicitly imputed to the global baseline and lower the coverage score.
